title: A light idea with shared responsibility

captions.emotions: Feeling fairness in the divided consequences

meaning: A spontaneous domestic decision becomes support when preparation and consequences are shared as clearly as the pleasure of a new idea.
text: You can organise shared life through clear responsibility: anticipating essentials, dividing work and taking a beginning to a usable result. The Emperor in the physical position of Muladhara describes this organisation. The Fool in energy tests your footing through an easy start without enough preparation: the idea is already happening although conditions remain undiscussed. Justice in emotions notices whether consequences have been fairly shared. A pleasant change can therefore leave different feelings when a decision was joint in words but arranging and finishing it quietly fell to one person.

For example, you spontaneously decide to repaint a small table. Beginning is enjoyable, but protective sheeting, drying space, clearing up and replacing possessions follow. **A shared idea includes the work after the first enthusiasm.** Recognising that part need not accuse anyone of insufficient lightness. Organisation supports the idea instead of becoming one person’s duty to provide every condition for a suggestion after interest has already moved elsewhere.

The difficulty is discussing fairness only after completion. Unequal effort has become resentment by then, while useful preparation seems an attempt to forbid novelty. You defend either freedom or responsibility although home needs both. A clear agreement about finishing leaves room for spontaneity without repeatedly establishing the cost of an unprepared beginning only afterwards.
